description: This notice encompasses all awardees of the MAC IDIQ and their respective contracts under Solicitation No. FA825226R0073. AAR Component Services Inc., Grand Prairie, Texas (FA8252-26-D-B004); AAR Aircraft Component Services, Wellington, Kansas (FA8252-26-D-B006); and Sherwood Aviation, Opa-locka, Florida (FA8252-26-D-B005) have been awarded a combined estimated ceiling $96,124,000 multiple-award, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for the F-16 Accessory Drive Gearbox (ADG) and Jet Fuel Starter (JFS) remanufacture. This contract was a competitive acquisition and three offers were received. Fiscal 2026 working capital funds in the total combined amount of $1,329,535 are being obligated at the time of award to each of the three vendors based on the minimum order quantity per their respective qualifications in accordance with the ordering procedures.
